title: 权限集的「审阅草稿」链接打开矩阵页，但那里没有审阅面板：软件包页和聊天里的「审阅 N 处改动」点进去看不到改了什么
body:
repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYkkwuF6UuFtu85Yd5H

④ sub-issue of #36890 · Source: #36903's os-dev report 7157551622 and its correction 7157568261. Seat repo:objectstack#4 accepted the `EditPage` carve-out on PR #37169 (7157282796); the dev's corrected recommendation is "A now, and file B". Part of #36890.

## 维护者速读

- 权限集有一个「审阅草稿」的链接(地址里带 `?review=1`),它会打开权限集自己的矩阵编辑页。但矩阵页上没有审阅面板,看不出这份草稿改了什么。
- 这样的链接今天就有两处会生成:软件包页上每条草稿的「审阅」链接,和聊天里的「审阅 N 处改动」按钮。主干上也是这样,不是新问题。
- 改法:让权限集的矩阵页认得 `?review=1`,打开时显示这份草稿相对已发布版本的改动(和其他类型的审阅面板一样)。

## What (measured at PR #37169's head `d3e30576`; re-measure on main when claimed)

- Producers that write `?review=1` for any draft item, a permission set included:
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx:1317` (the Packages page's per-draft review link);
  - `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:286` (the chat's 「Review N change(s)」, through `setupMetadataStudioPath`).
- The target: Studio's permission-set page (`StudioPermissionSetPage`, the matrix, which is the type's registered `EditPage`), and Setup's `PermissionMatrixEditPage`. Neither shows a draft review today.
- Make the matrix page honour `?review=1`: show the draft's change against the published set, in the same review sheet or presentation the generic item page uses, and keep editing available.
- Pins:
  - a permission-set `?review=1` address opens the matrix with the review shown;
  - CONTROL: without `?review=1` no review opens;
  - the flow and object review links are unchanged.

## Done when

- Both producers' links on a permission-set draft show what the draft changes.

## Notes

- Size S–M. Class (a): reachable today from the Packages page's draft list and the chat's review button.
- **Blocked-by:** #36903 (PR #37169), which changes how `?review=1` routes in Studio's area (the `EditPage` carve-out).
- Dedupe words: permission set review link, ?review=1 matrix, draft review sheet permission.
